purpose: Run independent benchmark workstreams in parallel while preserving dependency, safety, evidence, cost, and regression gates.
rules: Parallelize only independent work items or read-only discovery tasks.
Never run conflicting writes to the same file, environment, database, artifact, or state concurrently.
Serialize changes that share a dependency until the parent result is known.
Use sandbox/review scope for repairs; never merge main or deploy production automatically.
Every worker records baseline, diagnosis, proposed repair, targeted tests, benchmark result, and rollback/fallback.
Shared fixes trigger dependent-suite retesting before capability promotion.
A failed worker does not invalidate unrelated independent workers; its blocker is recorded and retried according to policy.
No paid model/API calls, secret changes, external contact, or destructive actions are permitted by this orchestration contract.
No worker may weaken, skip, or rewrite tests merely to obtain a pass.
Concurrency is bounded by available runner capacity, dependency graph constraints, and cost policy.
promotion_rule: Only measured passing evidence plus required dependent-suite retests may move a capability to mastered_candidate; final mastery requires repeated acceptance according to the benchmark definition.
fallback: If concurrency causes resource contention, reduce concurrency to the highest stable level and preserve task ordering from the dependency graph.
